$\blueD{72\%}$ $\greenD{\text{of}}$ $\maroonD{50}$ is the same as $\blueD{72\%}\greenD{\times}\maroonD{50}$.

To solve $\blueD{72\%}\greenD{\times}\maroonD{50}$, we need to convert $\blueD{72\%}$ to either a decimal or a fraction.

Percent means per hundred, so $\blueD{72\%}$ is equivalent to $\blueD{\dfrac{72}{100}}$ which is also equal to $\blueD{72\div 100=0.72}$.

 $\blueD{72\%= \dfrac{72}{100} = 0.72}$

$\begin{align}\blueD{72\%}\ \text{of}\ \maroonD{50}&=\blueD{\dfrac{72}{100}}\cdot\maroonD{50}\\\\
&=\blueD{0.72}\cdot\maroonD{50}\\\\
&=36
\end{align}$

Are any of the other choices equivalent?

$72\cdot \dfrac{5}{100}=3.6$

The expression $72\cdot \dfrac{5}{100}$ is **not** equivalent to $72\%$ of $50$.

$72\cdot 50=3{,}600$

The expression $72\cdot 50$ is **not** equivalent to $72\%$ of $50$.

$\dfrac{72}{50}\cdot 100=144$

The expression $\dfrac{72}{50}\cdot 100$ is **not** equivalent to $72\%$ of $50$.

The options that have the same value as $72\%$ of $50$ are:

- $\dfrac{72}{100}\cdot 50$
- $0.72\cdot 50$
